a.lede: Two gaming PCs capable of 1080p gameplay have dropped below $1,000, a price that's hard to beat in the current market, thanks to sales at Best Buy and Walmart.
a.title: Score a 1080p gaming PC for less than $1,000 right now, fitted with Nvidia or AMD GPUs

b.lede: The price increase on refurbished PS5 Pros comes as the console remains out of stock at MSRP on various retailers, including directly from Sony. Best Buy and Walmart have new units in stock, but at around $1,500 each.
b.title: Used PS5 Pros now cost $1,399 at GameStop, 50% more than new ones
